################################################################################
# pgie_facedetect_config.txt
# Primary GIE Configuration - Face Detection
#
# Model: NVIDIA TAO FaceDetectIR (ResNet18, pruned)
# Output: Bounding boxes for detected faces (class 0 = "face")
#
# The model is in .etlt format (encrypted TensorRT-loadable).
# TensorRT engine will be auto-generated on first run for the target GPU.
################################################################################

[property]
gpu-id=0
net-scale-factor=1.0
offsets=103.939;116.779;123.68
model-color-format=1

# ─────────────── Model File Paths ───────────────
# TAO encrypted model (.etlt) — auto-converts to TensorRT engine
tlt-encoded-model=/workspace/models/facedetect/resnet18_facedetectir_pruned.etlt
tlt-model-key=tlt_encode
labelfile-path=/workspace/models/facedetect/labels.txt

# If you pre-generated a TensorRT engine, use this instead:
# model-engine-file=/workspace/models/facedetect/resnet18_facedetectir_pruned.etlt_b1_gpu0_fp16.engine

# ─────────────── Network Configuration ───────────────
batch-size=1
# 0=FP32, 1=INT8, 2=FP16
# FP16 recommended for Blackwell GPU (best perf/accuracy balance)
network-mode=2
num-detected-classes=1
interval=0
gie-unique-id=1
process-mode=1
network-type=0

# ─────────────── Input Dimensions ───────────────
# FaceDetectIR expects 3x544x960 input
infer-dims=3;544;960

# ─────────────── Detection Parameters ───────────────
# Clustering for merging overlapping detections
cluster-mode=2
maintain-aspect-ratio=1

[class-attrs-all]
pre-cluster-threshold=0.4
nms-iou-threshold=0.4
minBoxes=0
